children.name: amount
children.label: Amount
children.inline_help_text: Enter the exact product price as used in Stripe. Use only digits and a dot (e.g., 19.99).
children.validation_error_message: Only numbers are allowed, with an optional decimal point. The number cannot begin with 0.

children.name: product_id
children.label: Product Id
children.inline_help_text: Enter the Stripe Product ID (e.g., prod_Rr0...). In Stripe, go to Products → select your product → copy the Product ID from the product section. Make sure it matches the amount you entered above.
